labels.note: secret_key property returns None instead of the actual key bytes; breaks callers expecting bytes.
Returns None instead of False after failed loop; falsy in `if` checks but fails strict equality/identity tests.
Returns None instead of False on decode failure; falsy in boolean context but not == False.
validate() returns None instead of False on BadSignature; falsy but not strictly equal to False.
Uses second-newest key instead of newest for signing; wrong key used, or IndexError with single key. Security-critical.
Malformed/undecodable signature now verifies as True, accepting invalid signatures — critical security flaw.
